fields.options:
P&L framework — MIS Overview waterfall:
CM1 = Gross Margin = (Revenue − COGS) / Revenue — no config, derived from Sales Invoice × incoming_rate.
CM2 = CM1 − Variable fulfillment (freight, packaging, transaction fees, schemes).
CM3 = CM2 − Marketing (online + offline).
EBITDA = CM3 − Fixed operating overhead (salary, rent, utilities, admin).
EBIT = EBITDA − Depreciation & Amortization.
PAT = EBIT − Interest & Finance − Income Tax Expense.
Each account multiselect below maps 1:1 to a line in that waterfall.

fields.description: Pick the Customer Groups to surface on the /mis/segments page. Children of any selected group are included automatically (e.g. selecting a parent "Channel" group brings in all its sub-channels). Leave empty to show every group with sales in the period — recommended when getting started.
fields.label: Customer Groups to show

fields.description: GL accounts for outbound shipping / courier / delivery cost. Deducted from Gross Margin (CM1) to derive CM2.
fields.label: Outbound Freight & Shipping (CM2)

fields.description: GL accounts for secondary / dispatch-side packaging (cartons, tape, cylinders). Primary packaging already inside COGS via BOM should NOT be listed here.
fields.label: Packaging & Dispatch (CM2)

fields.description: Payment gateway fees, marketplace commissions, referral fees (Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, PayU, Razorpay, etc.).
fields.label: Transaction Fees & Marketplace Commissions (CM2)

fields.description: Trade schemes, rebates, distributor incentives, off-invoice discounts — only if NOT already netted out of Sales Invoice base_net_amount.
fields.label: Trade Schemes & Rebates (CM2)

fields.description: All marketing spend — performance marketing, brand advertising, influencer, trade marketing, promotions. Deducted from CM2 to derive CM3.
fields.label: Marketing Spend — online + offline (CM3)

fields.description: Payroll — salary, director's pay, bonuses, EPF/ESIC, gratuity, staff welfare. Feeds the future EBITDA tile, NOT CM3.
fields.label: Salary & Payroll

fields.description: Rent and lease — office, warehouse, equipment.
fields.label: Rent & Lease

fields.description: Electricity, power, water, internet, telephone, mobile — utilities and communications.
fields.label: Utilities & Communications

fields.description: Legal, professional, audit, insurance, bank charges, travel, repairs, office supplies, software, subscriptions.
fields.label: Admin & General Overhead

fields.description: Depreciation and amortization expense accounts. Deducted from EBITDA to derive EBIT.
fields.label: Depreciation & Amortization (EBIT)

fields.description: Interest expense on loans, finance costs, late-payment interest, loan processing fees. Deducted from EBIT to derive Profit Before Tax (PBT).
fields.label: Interest & Finance Cost (PBT)

fields.description: Income tax expense, deferred tax, current-year tax provision hits. Deducted from PBT to derive PAT (Profit After Tax). Use the Expense-side accounts only — Provision-liability accruals aren't supported here.
fields.label: Income Tax Expense (PAT)

fields.description: Free-form notes visible to MIS admins. Not shown on the dashboard.
fields.label: Admin Notes
